scope: Rank-32 close-up-curriculum H3 r3 epoch-0 checkpoint, three-scale held-out tournament, and capability-aware early stop
summary: The r3 epoch-0 checkpoint completed, but scales 1.0, 0.5, and 0.25 all reproduce the same shoulder/head topology failure and all regress matched motion. The full contract rejects every candidate, so epoch 1 was interrupted after 35/120 steps and emitted no checkpoint.
evidence: The ten-clip v3 dataset manifest SHA-256 is 14f4a55133e41dd7d79d90792a4c23545bf61ea2b998a57e40987843d5f340f0.
Epoch 0 completed 120 optimizer steps and produced a 131,227,832-byte checkpoint with SHA-256 ce324f0950530e3e007e8a918c2bce15bb1d5484759deb136be936801bef7831.

The scale-1.0, 0.5, and 0.25 videos have SHA-256 values 28bdbdccea93e8acd5e091738a1aadd506af6c8f2098fb7c4c7168ddb6e1bf85, 40b08fdb8a37c76b1a6926451ea3fd98401ec306bfe221dabd6c073991acbc1a, and 694cb32f5295d19d3eae955ed522e28fc856ec7316640969e46d20b76b37052a.

Every scale has complete 124-frame decoded SHA coverage and twelve-gate labels, but only 24/124 frames pass; 100 fail left shoulder attachment, unique left root, head/neck clearance, and proportions, while 82 also fail the head-to-torso chain.
Matched motion-profile ratios are 0.9123695233, 0.9086654559, and 0.9688105168 for scales 1.0, 0.5, and 0.25, all below the 0.99 non-regression floor.
Component-wise action adherence is 0.9981229520, 1.0, and 0.9868221646; scale 0.25 additionally fails action non-regression because object lock regresses.

The three assessment SHA-256 values are a054400969e25e47298b2f190915d600366e0782ec906198e8d8eac6d270f19f, b1ce1fcaf028f07e88803060539cd73854d1dfdbcba5d55d5b060d3be9fd3b2a, and d3cab86e84f317b42ec63c25b235fab06c9b255e71718a482d9f8d3312af97d5.

The stopped training manifest records status=failed, honest_status=PARTIAL, exit -2/KeyboardInterrupt, one preserved checkpoint, and epoch-1 progress 35/120; its local copy SHA-256 is cf7f6e0c4c9bffedce9cbe4eff290a866372993aa0edb387ea5d9d84369f2120.
lessons: Adding shoulder close-ups from the same synthetic renderer did not bridge the held-out real-scene topology domain gap.
A LoRA-scale sweep can separate capability regression from structural benefit: here every scale loses motion and none improves the hard topology conjunction.
Stopping after the first fully reviewed checkpoint prevents additional optimization in a direction that has already failed both structural and capability gates.
limitations: The evidence covers one held-out identity, scene, and action using third-party NF4 H3 weights.
The running r3 process predated strict deterministic-kernel enforcement, so no deterministic-training claim is made.
The 2-D semantic topology review does not establish hidden 3-D kinematics, physical contact, or real-robot execution.
No learned candidate is perfect or releaseable, and none is presented as an improved H3 demo.
next_actions: Require camera/domain-diverse real-background positives and multiple frozen held-out scenes before another learned round.
Use step-level immutable checkpoints under strict deterministic kernels, and stop at the first topology or capability regression.
Route rejected learned outputs only through an independently accepted structure-preserving fallback.
